policy: Official sources only. Aggregators may be used to discover stories, but every published item must be verified against the primary post before it goes out.

ingestion_notes.rss: Read directly with the n8n RSS Read node.
ingestion_notes.html: No native RSS feed exists. Read the listed index page with an HTTP Request node + HTML Extract node (or a feed-generator service), then verify against the primary post.
ingestion_notes.huggingface_caveat: The Hugging Face feed omits per-item <link> tags in some readers; derive the canonical URL from the item guid if link is empty.

sources.name: Anthropic
sources.note: No official native RSS. Read the news index page (HTTP + HTML Extract). Engineering posts: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering

sources.name: Google Research
sources.note: Blogger-hosted; the /feeds/posts/default?alt=rss path is the standard RSS endpoint.

sources.name: Meta AI
sources.note: No confirmed official native RSS. Read the blog index (HTTP + HTML Extract).

sources.name: Microsoft AI
sources.note: WordPress site; /feed/ is the standard endpoint. Confirm it loads before relying on it.
